newsitem.title: USA: Sioux Falls cattle up $0.50 - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Sioux Falls cattle up $0.50 - USDA.

text.p: USDA said slaughter steers and heifers were active. Both classes traded $0.50 higher, instances $0.75 higher. Demand was good.
Steers - high select and choice 2-3 1200-1350 lbs 67.00- 69.50. Select and choice 2-3 1100-1300 lbs 66.00-67.00. Select 1-2 63.50-66.00.
Heifers - high select and choice 2-3 1050-1300 lbs 66.00-68.00. Select and choice 2-3 950-1100 lbs 63.50-66.00. Select 1-2 62.50-63.50.
